faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Hyderabad Post-doctoral Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Post-doctoral Research Fellow position at IIT Hyderabad is 15th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the PDF post?
faq.answer: Candidates should have a PhD/Masters in Biomedical Engineering, Life sciences, Biotechnology, Chemical engineering, or equivalent Biosciences degrees with 60% marks or equivalent CGPA.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any post-PhD research experience required?
faq.answer: Yes, one year of post-PhD research experience with demonstrable skills in liver/pancreas research or organoid or primary cell culture is required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Post-doctoral Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Post-doctoral Research Fellow position is 38 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive approximately Rs. 87,000 per month, which includes HRA.

faq.question: Q6. How will the candidates be selected for the Post-doctoral Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an Online Interview.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Post-doctoral Research Fellow (PDF) position.

faq.question: Q9. In which mode can candidates apply for this position?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online for the Post-doctoral Research Fellow position.

faq.question: Q10. Where is IIT Hyderabad located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Hyderabad is located in Hyderabad, Telangana, with a pincode of 502284.
